picross.uniqueNote: Every puzzle is verified to have exactly one solution reachable by logic alone—no guessing. The daily puzzle is the same for everyone and changes at midnight KST.
picross.title: Picross
picross.description: Logic puzzle game - fill cells using number clues to reveal a picture
picross.helpClick: Tap or drag to fill/mark several cells at once
guideRulesItems: Number clues on rows and columns indicate consecutive filled cells.
There must be at least one empty cell between groups of filled cells.
Fill cells to satisfy all clues and reveal the hidden picture.
0 means no cells are filled in that row/column.
guideTipsItems: Start with rows/columns that have large number clues.
When the clue sum is close to the grid size, use overlap technique to find definite cells.
Mark empty cells with X to help with reasoning.
Clues of rows/columns that are satisfied fade out, so only the remaining lines stand out.
guideControlsItems: Pick a tool with the 'Fill / Mark X' buttons above, then tap cells.
Press and drag to fill or clear several cells along one line at once.
On PC, right-click marks X; on keyboard use Enter (current tool) or the X key.
Tap a filled cell again to clear it. Turn off 'Show mistakes instantly' to solve without hints.
